##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 3: the Conquerors (generated by tools/gen_script_conq.py)
##########################################################################

# The conqueror won: every county of the target kingdom held by the defender's realm or the conqueror loses a level of
# development (a third lose a second), takes the ravaged modifier, may take the conqueror's culture, and its provinces lose buildings.
# Expects scope:eir_conq_title and scope:eir_conqueror; root = the defender.
eir_conq_ravage_effect = {
	scope:eir_conq_title = {
		every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						top_liege = root
						top_liege = scope:eir_conqueror
					}
				}
			}
			change_development_level = -1
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_ravaged_modifier
				years = 20
			}
			random = {
				chance = 35
				change_development_level = -1
			}
			random = {
				chance = 45
				set_county_culture = scope:eir_conqueror.culture
			}
			every_county_province = {
				eir_ravage_province_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	add_prestige = massive_prestige_loss
	add_stress = medium_stress_gain
	remove_global_variable = eir_conq_active
}

# The conqueror lost: the realm's counties of the target kingdom are proud and prosperous for a while.
eir_conq_victory_effect = {
	scope:eir_conq_title = {
		every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= { top_liege = root }
			}
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_liberated_county_modifier
				years = 15
			}
		}
	}
	add_prestige = massive_prestige_gain
	add_piety = medium_piety_gain
	remove_global_variable = eir_conq_active
}

# Ends a conqueror's chain with no victor (a white peace, or the war simply died).
eir_conq_clear_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_active }
		remove_global_variable = eir_conq_active
	}
}

			remove_building = eir_cattle_enclosure_t_01
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fosterage_hall_04 }
			remove_building = eir_fosterage_hall_04
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_fosterage_hall_03 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fosterage_hall_03 }
			remove_building = eir_fosterage_hall_03
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_fosterage_hall_02 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fosterage_hall_02 }
			remove_building = eir_fosterage_hall_02
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_fosterage_hall_01 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fosterage_hall_01 }
			remove_building = eir_fosterage_hall_01
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fosterage_hall_t_02 }
			remove_building = eir_fosterage_hall_t_02
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_fosterage_hall_t_01 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fosterage_hall_t_01 }
			remove_building = eir_fosterage_hall_t_01
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_ogham_stones_04 }
			remove_building = eir_ogham_stones_04
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_ogham_stones_03 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_ogham_stones_03 }
			remove_building = eir_ogham_stones_03
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_ogham_stones_02 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_ogham_stones_02 }
			remove_building = eir_ogham_stones_02
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_ogham_stones_01 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_ogham_stones_01 }
			remove_building = eir_ogham_stones_01
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_ogham_stones_t_02 }
			remove_building = eir_ogham_stones_t_02
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_ogham_stones_t_01 }
		}
		else_if = {

			remove_building = eir_ogham_stones_t_01
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fianna_lodge_04 }
			remove_building = eir_fianna_lodge_04
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_fianna_lodge_03 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fianna_lodge_03 }
			remove_building = eir_fianna_lodge_03
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_fianna_lodge_02 }

		else_if = {
			limit = { has_building = eir_fianna_lodge_02 }
			remove_building = eir_fianna_lodge_02
			hidden_effect = { add_building = eir_fianna_lodge_01 }
		}
		else_if = {

		else_if = {

		if = {

# Conqueror 1 (The English King): picks the warlord (scope:eir_conqueror) and the title he wants (scope:eir_conq_title). root = the defender.
eir_conq_pick_1_effect = {
	random_ruler = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_west_germanic }
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		weight = {
			base = 1
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				max_military_strength >= 3000
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_conqueror
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eir_conq_realm_holds_trigger = { T = k_scotland } }
		title:k_scotland = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_title }
	}
	else = {
		title:k_ireland = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_title }
	}
	scope:eir_conq_title = {
		random_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_county
				is_coastal_county = yes
				holder ?= { top_liege = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_conq_landing
		}
	}
}

# Conqueror 1: the host lands and the war begins. Expects scope:eir_conqueror and scope:eir_conq_title; root = the defender.
eir_conq_launch_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:eir_conq_landing } }
		scope:eir_conq_title.holder.capital_county = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_landing }
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = eir_conq_lord_var
		value = scope:eir_conqueror
	}
	set_global_variable = eir_conq_active
	scope:eir_conqueror = {
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_conq_id
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_conq_title
			value = scope:eir_conq_title
		}
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = eir_conqueror_modifier
			years = 8
		}
		add_pressed_claim = scope:eir_conq_title
		spawn_army = {
			levies = 5500
			men_at_arms = {
				type = armored_footmen
				stacks = 8
			}
			men_at_arms = {
				type = light_footmen
				stacks = 8
			}
			men_at_arms = {
				type = armored_horsemen
				stacks = 6
			}
			men_at_arms = {
				type = bowmen
				stacks = 8
			}
			location = scope:eir_conq_landing.title_province
			origin = capital_province
			inheritable = no
			uses_supply = no
			name = eir_conq1_host_name
		}
		add_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
		start_war = {
			cb = claim_cb
			target = scope:eir_conq_title.holder
			claimant = scope:eir_conqueror
			target_title = scope:eir_conq_title
		}
		remove_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
	}
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0613 days = 160 }
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0614 days = 1300 }
}

# Conqueror 5 (The King's Marshal): picks the warlord (scope:eir_conqueror) and the title he wants (scope:eir_conq_title). root = the defender.
eir_conq_pick_5_effect = {
	random_ruler = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
			OR = {
					culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_west_germanic }
					culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_frankish }
				}
			NOT = { has_truce = root }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		weight = {
			base = 1
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				max_military_strength >= 3000
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = eir_conqueror
	}
	if = {
		limit = { eir_conq_realm_holds_trigger = { T = k_ireland } }
		title:k_ireland = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_title }
	}
	else = {
		title:k_scotland = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_title }
	}
	scope:eir_conq_title = {
		random_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_county
				is_coastal_county = yes
				holder ?= { top_liege = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_conq_landing
		}
	}
}

# Conqueror 5: the host lands and the war begins. Expects scope:eir_conqueror and scope:eir_conq_title; root = the defender.
eir_conq_launch_5_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:eir_conq_landing } }
		scope:eir_conq_title.holder.capital_county = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_landing }
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = eir_conq_lord_var
		value = scope:eir_conqueror
	}
	set_global_variable = eir_conq_active
	scope:eir_conqueror = {
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_conq_id
			value = 5
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = eir_conq_title
			value = scope:eir_conq_title
		}
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = eir_conqueror_modifier
			years = 8
		}
		add_pressed_claim = scope:eir_conq_title
		spawn_army = {
			levies = 5300
			men_at_arms = {
				type = armored_horsemen
				stacks = 10
			}
			men_at_arms = {
				type = armored_footmen
				stacks = 8
			}
			men_at_arms = {
				type = bowmen
				stacks = 8
			}
			men_at_arms = {
				type = light_footmen
				stacks = 4
			}
			location = scope:eir_conq_landing.title_province
			origin = capital_province
			inheritable = no
			uses_supply = no
			name = eir_conq5_host_name
		}
		add_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
		start_war = {
			cb = claim_cb
			target = scope:eir_conq_title.holder
			claimant = scope:eir_conqueror
			target_title = scope:eir_conq_title
		}
		remove_character_flag = temp_no_claim_war_cost
	}
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0653 days = 160 }
	trigger_event = { id = eir.0654 days = 1300 }
}
